artifacts.title: Apache James RCE to email credentials and cron tmp.py root (SolidState)
artifacts.starting_access: unauthenticated access to Apache James and web services on a Linux host
artifacts.outcome: root via overwriting a root-executed cron script
transferable_properties: Apache James 2.3.2 Remote Administration Tool has a known RCE via user/path injection
the James admin can reset any user's password to read their email
email services can leak SSH credentials
check all linpeas output and the full attack surface, not just the web
a root cron script in a world-writable path is a privesc vector

observations: a CVE allows injecting a bash_completion user executed at login

hypotheses.statement: Apache James RCE and password reset can yield credentials

selected_action.intent: exploit James to plant a payload and reset the mindy password to read her email

evidence.summary: planted a bash_completion.d payload via James, reset mindy's password, and read an email containing SSH credentials

observations: the email reveals mindy's SSH password
the planted payload fires on SSH login

hypotheses.statement: SSHing as mindy triggers the reverse shell

selected_action.intent: log in over SSH as mindy to trigger the planted payload and read the user flag

evidence.summary: logged in over SSH as mindy, the payload gave a reverse shell, and the user flag was obtained

observations: linpeas shows no easy SUID/CVE path
/opt/tmp.py is world-writable and executed by root via cron

hypotheses.statement: overwriting tmp.py makes root execute a reverse shell

selected_action.intent: overwrite /opt/tmp.py with a reverse shell and wait for the root cron

evidence.summary: overwrote tmp.py with a nc reverse shell and obtained a root shell when the cron fired
